stories.title: Washington state health officials urge vaccination after U.S. loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: The U.S. has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, prompting West Coast states, including Washington, to urge vaccinations amidst rising cases.

stories.title: Kitsap County Airbnb owner accused of bear-spraying guests, threatening them with replica gun
stories.summary: Deputies say the owner threw an Airsoft pistol into a shrub beneath a deck before surrendering at the Silverdale rental.

stories.title: Seattle police seek man accused of hate crime after pulling off woman’s hijab on Capitol Hill
stories.summary: A man told the woman “you should not be wearing that” as he pulled off her hijab, according to Seattle police.

stories.title: Tacoma immigration attorney sues over H1-B delay keeping her from defending immigrants
stories.summary: A Seattle University law graduate cannot begin her planned job defending detained immigrants, according to a federal lawsuit.

stories.title: Seattle store sues over six-month SNAP ban tied to $4.99 plastic cutlery sale
stories.summary: The store calls the sale an isolated mistake. USDA says one improper transaction can justify a six-month disqualification.

stories.title: Fall City teen accused of killing 5 family members appears in court, pleads not guilty
stories.summary: King County Judge Veronica Galván previously ruled the teen will be tried as an adult.

stories.title: Emergency repairs close I-5 express lanes in Seattle
stories.summary: Express lanes of Interstate 5 and all express lane ramps are closed in Seattle as crews make emergency repairs, according to WSDOT.

stories.title: More teens are calling Washington Poison Center. AI chatbots are helping them get there
stories.summary: The Washington Poison Center says calls involving teenagers have risen roughly 50%, while the number of calls coming directly from teens has doubled.

stories.title: New film group to lead revival of Capitol Hill landmark Egyptian Theater
stories.summary: Seattle’s historic Egyptian Theater will reopen Dec. 4 after a two-year closure, with four friends leading its revival as a weekend destination for film fans.

stories.title: Healthcare workers at Tacoma's St. Joseph announce strike
stories.summary: Over 200 healthcare workers at St. Joseph Medical Center in Tacoma are planning a three-day strike beginning Wednesday, Dec. 2.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Police determined "unexploded device" that prompted evacuations is a commercial firework
stories.summary: A report of a possible explosive device caused evacuations in Belmont and Appaloosa around 5 p.m. Monday.

stories.title: Seattle considers renaming Jackson Park, adding new recreational amenities
stories.summary: The park, which is currently named after former President Andrew Jackson, is near the new Pinehurst Link light rail station.
